issue.body:
Correction task for #1388 and the strategic entry-state part of #1355. The completed ic2-conquest investigation [PR #167](https://github.com/diegoami/ic2-conquest/pull/167) attributes the Seleucid `(212,96)` versus `(212,94)` endpoint to two coupled differences: original reachability accepts the western 7,000-troop target `(191,95)`, and its destination wrapper routes toward intermediate `(189,104)`. The remake filters that target through direct-walk `IsReachable`, chooses `(207,95)`, then calls its low-level walker directly. The low-level walker matched all 21 measured steps for the three conditional destinations, so a target-only change is insufficient.

Prepare the bounded production correction in `docs/tasks/T212.md`. Start after the finding is promoted/evaluated in the research repository; its current conquest copy is a partial, one-campaign report. Do not hardcode owner coordinates, make every target reachable, change tactical combat, or alter save schemas. Reproduce the target, route and endpoint on the private owner boundary plus synthetic region/coast/contact/fleet controls; run full strategic and CI gates. Keep #1388 and #1355 open until their own acceptance is met.

The gap now has a concrete reachable history: mercenary entry inherits zero from EE60's exhausted loop counter. If its nested route is refused, DB38 writes−1 into the deeper slot later reused by garrison. With the identical blocked corridor, absent offer finishes with0moves; present but unreachable offer leaves9. Progress-then-block retains7moves with the negative guard, while the zero-guard control recurses and reaches signed moves−1 because the extra decrement is unconditional. A universal fresh zero would fail these controls. The guard affects cleanup/recursion, not the initial direct walk.

Ordinary F31C destination/garrison and nested mercenary/garrison use different stack depths; do not propagate every earlier refusal indiscriminately. Exact source writer addresses and S−18/S−42 relationships are documented. Arbitrary standalone roots remain uninitialized, and other interception/combat/embarked histories are not universally proved.

The full native military phase on that retained diagnostic boundary still selects a city branch, so the End-turn/battle-entry claim is **not** met.
